name: Audio Leveler
author: G-Hancox
description: Makes every song in your show play at the same loudness, while songs meant to sit under the show stay there. On FPP 10.4+ it works with FPP's own Normalize, so files are never changed, and adds what Normalize doesn't: each song's loudness, peaks and clipping, notes on what it did and what might sound better, Background levels for ambiance, automatic leveling of new and re-uploaded songs, an optional true-peak limiter for songs Normalize leaves short, and a fix for MP3s that play 25 ms late on FPP. On FPP 10.0-10.3 it levels the files itself (losslessly for MP3s where it can) and keeps backups. Videos too, without touching the picture. Work waits until no show is playing. Runs entirely on this device using ffmpeg.

privacy.summary: Runs on this device only. Levels songs through FPP's Normalize (10.4+) or by rewriting them (older FPP, or limiter by choice), with backups.

collects.what: Backup copies of the songs and videos you level, and their loudness measurements

systemChanges.what: Sets per-song volume through FPP's Normalize on FPP 10.4+ (files unchanged), for the songs and videos you level or new uploads if switched on.
Rewrites a song only without Normalize (FPP 10.0-10.3), when you choose the limiter or compression, or to fix an MP3's timing tag. Backed up.
